policies.text: Hazardous cargo transit clearance is issued when a shipping enterprise possesses a maritime hazard handling permit.
Expedited border pass authorization is granted to a company with preferred level transit status that maintains a customs compliance score of at least 90 percent.
Cold-chain operating approval is granted when a logistics firm maintains a warehouse temperature control rating of at least 95 percent.
An aviation provider receives high-altitude flight approval when maintaining an annual crew safety score of at least 90 points.
A rail transport operator secures trackway access rights by maintaining a network line length of at least 500 kilometers.
Qualification for international dispatch services requires a freight firm with expedited border pass authorization to retain a safety supervisor headcount of at least 3 officers.
Overland freight qualification is established when a transport company operates an active heavy vehicle fleet of at least 20 trucks.
Transit status at the preferred level is awarded when a freight enterprise maintains an active fleet size of at least 15 aircraft or completes a monthly shipment volume of at least 100 cargo flights.
Awarding of a worldwide logistics charter is recommended for a freight company cleared for international dispatch that maintains transit liability insurance coverage of at least $5,000,000.
